SERVER_NAME = 'sysflow-repro-node-py'
NODE_TYPE = 'compute_haswell'
IMAGE_NAME = 'CC-Ubuntu20.04'
LOCAL_TRACE_DIR = "./traces"
REMOTE_TRACE_FILE = "/mnt/traces/mitre-simulation.sf"
LOCAL_TRACE_FILE = os.path.join(LOCAL_TRACE_DIR, "mitre-simulation.sf")
ANALYSIS_HTML_FILE = "attack_timeline.html"


def install_local_dependencies():
    """Installs Python libraries required for the analysis section."""
    print("--- Checking and installing local Python dependencies for analysis ---")
    dependencies = ['pandas', 'plotly', 'sysflow']
    for package in dependencies:
        try:
            __import__(package)
            print(f"{package} is already installed.")
        except ImportError:
            print(f"Installing {package}...")
            subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", package])
    print("--- Local dependencies are ready. ---\n")

lease_id = None
server_id = None

try:
    # SECTION 2: LEASE AND PROVISION COMPUTE NODE
    reservations = [{
        'resource_type': 'physical:host',
        'min': 1, 'max': 1,
        'resource_properties': f'["=", "$node_type", "{NODE_TYPE}"]'
    }]
    lease = chi.lease.create_lease(LEASE_NAME, reservations)
    lease_id = lease['id']
    print(f"Lease created with ID: {lease_id}")

    print("Waiting for lease to become active...")
    chi.lease.wait_for_active(lease_id)
    print("Lease is now active!")

    print(f"--- Creating server '{SERVER_NAME}' ---")
    server_reservation = chi.lease.get_node_reservation(lease_id)
    server = chi.server.create_server(SERVER_NAME, image_name=IMAGE_NAME, reservation_id=server_reservation)
    server_id = server.id
    print(f"Server created with ID: {server_id}")

    print("Waiting for server to become active...")
    chi.server.wait_for_active(server_id)
    print("Server is now active!")

    print("--- Associating floating IP address ---")
    ip = chi.server.associate_floating_ip(server_id)
    print(f"Server is accessible at IP address: {ip}")
    chi.server.wait_for_tcp(ip, port=22) # Wait for SSH to be ready

# SECTION 3: REMOTE INSTALLATION AND ATTACK SIMULATION
    print(f"\n--- Connecting to server at {ip} via SSH ---")
    conn = SshConnection(ip=ip, user='cc')
    print("SSH connection successful!")

    print("\n--- Installing Docker and Git on the remote node ---")
    conn.run('sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y docker.io git')
    print("Docker and Git installed successfully.")

    print("\n--- Running the SysFlow collector in the background ---")
    conn.run('mkdir -p /mnt/traces')
    collector_cmd = (
        'sudo docker run -d --name sf-collector --rm '
        '-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock '
        '-v /dev:/dev --privileged '
        '-v /mnt/traces:/mnt/traces '
        'sysflow/sf-collector:latest -w ' + REMOTE_TRACE_FILE
    )
    conn.run(collector_cmd)
    print("SysFlow collector is now running.")
    time.sleep(10)  # Give the collector time to start up

    print("\n--- Simulating MITRE ATT&CK discovery techniques ---")
    conn.run('git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team.git')
    
    print("Executing T1082 - System Information Discovery...")
    conn.run('hostname && whoami && uname -a')
    
    print("Executing T1057 - Process Discovery...")
    conn.run('ps aux')

    print("Executing T1087 - Account Discovery...")
    conn.run('cat /etc/passwd')
    print("Attack simulation complete.")

    print("\n--- Stopping the SysFlow collector ---")
    time.sleep(5)  # Ensure all activity is logged
    conn.run('sudo docker stop sf-collector')
    print("Collector stopped. Trace saved on remote node.")

    # SECTION 4: DATA RETRIEVAL AND LOCAL ANALYSIS
    print(f"\n--- Downloading trace file from {ip} to {LOCAL_TRACE_FILE} ---")
    os.makedirs(LOCAL_TRACE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    conn.get_file(REMOTE_TRACE_FILE, LOCAL_TRACE_FILE)
    print("Trace file downloaded successfully.")
    
    # Install local dependencies needed for analysis
    install_local_dependencies()
    from sysflow.reader import SFReader
    import sysflow.utils as su

    print("\n--- Starting local analysis of the trace file ---")
    reader = SFReader(LOCAL_TRACE_FILE)
    data = []

    for rec in reader:
        if rec.rec_type == 'PE' and not rec.get('proc.anonymized'):
            pe = rec.get_fields()
            tags = pe.get('tags.mitre', [])
            if not tags:
                tags = ['T-Other']
            
            for tag in tags:
                data.append({
                    'Task': pe['proc.exe'],
                    'Start': su.to_datetime(pe['ts']),
                    'Finish': su.to_datetime(pe['ts'] + 10000000),  # Add 10ms duration for visibility
                    'Resource': tag,
                    'Cmdline': pe['proc.cmdline']
                })

    df = pd.DataFrame(data)
    print(f"Found and processed {len(df)} tagged events.")

    if not df.empty:
        print("Generating interactive timeline plot...")
        fig = px.timeline(
            df,
            x_start="Start",
            x_end="Finish",
            y="Task",
            color="Resource",
            hover_name="Cmdline",
            title="Process Activity Timeline by MITRE ATT&CK Tag",
            color_discrete_map={
                'T-Other': 'lightgrey',
                'T1082': 'orange',
                'T1057': 'red',
                'T1087': 'purple'
            }
        )
        fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed")
        fig.write_html(ANALYSIS_HTML_FILE)
        print(f"Analysis complete. Report saved to: {os.path.abspath(ANALYSIS_HTML_FILE)}")
    else:
        print("No tagged attack data found to visualize.")

finally:
    # SECTION 5: CLEAN UP RESOURCES
    print("\n--- Starting resource cleanup ---")
    if server_id:
        try:
            print(f"Deleting server {server_id}...")
            chi.server.delete_server(server_id)
            print("Server deleted successfully.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error deleting server: {e}")

    if lease_id:
        try:
            print(f"Deleting lease {lease_id}...")
            chi.lease.delete_lease(lease_id)
            print("Lease deleted successfully.")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error deleting lease: {e}")
    
    print("\nCleanup finished.")
